verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਦਾਰਾ ਕੋ ਦਰਸੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਚਾਹੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖਤ ਹੈ ਨ ਚਾਹ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise paradhaaraa ko dharas dhirag dhekhio chaahai taise gur dharasan dhekhat hai na chaeh kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a forgetful person does not desire a glimpse of his Guru with the same intensity that he uses his eyes to ogle at other women.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰਨਿੰਦਾ ਸੁਨੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਨੈ ਨ ਉਤਸਾਹ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise parani(n)dhaa sunai saavadhaan surat kai taiso gur sabadh sunai na utasaeh kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a worldly man listens to the slander of other persons very attentively, he does not listen to the divine words of Guru with same fondness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਹਰਨ ਕਉ ਚਰਨ ਧਾਵੈ ਤੈਸੇ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨ ਉਮਾਹ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise par dharab haran kau charan dhaavai taise keeratan saadhasa(n)gat na umaeh kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a person greedy of wealth walks a distance to cheat another person of his hard earned money, he does not show the same enthusiasm of going to the divine congregation to listen to the adulations of Almighty.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਲੂ ਕਾਗ ਨਾਗਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਕਉ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਊਚ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਨੀਚ ਪਦੁ ਗਾਹ ਕੈ ॥੫੦੮॥
verses.translit_en: auloo kaag naag dhiaan khaan paan kau na jaanai uooch padh paavai nahee neech padh gaeh kai ||508||

en.bdb: Like an owl, crow and snake, I do not know the value of radiance, sweet smelling traits and relishment of Naam of the True Guru. Doing inferior deeds, I have lowered my status and can't attain a high spiritual state. (508)
